component: Thundermail menu and upload identity guards

quotes.text: throw new Error("Cannot upload: user session is missing a user id (ownerId would be empty).");

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The v2.0.2 menu reads stored auth and treats a refresh token plus a username as its signed-in display state. It no longer closes all Send tabs because an access token expired. Upload separately retries a missing reactive user.id through populateFromBackend and throws if that id is still absent before upload work. Menu state is not token validity, and the user-id guard is not a network or successful-upload guarantee. The manifest ships these bounded emitted functions as v2.0.2; broad generated payload and upstream provider/build behavior remain outside the audit.
title: The add-on menu checks refresh-token presence while upload requires a backend user id
